headline: Bloomberg reports Nscale and Anthropic near another $45 billion compute deal
body: Bloomberg reports that Nscale and Anthropic are said to be on the verge of announcing another $45 billion compute deal, citing people familiar with the matter. The sources cautioned that talks are still underway and that the details could change. A little over a month ago, Anthropic and Nscale announced a $45 billion compute deal.
note: TechCrunch reports that some investors worry the spending is too high for too little profit. Both Anthropic and Nscale are pursuing IPOs.

evidence.text: A little over a month ago, Anthropic and AI infrastructure provider Nscale announced a $45 billion compute deal .
Bloomberg reports that the two companies are said to be on the verge of announcing yet another $45 billion compute deal, citing people familiar with the matter.
Those sources cautioned that talks are still underway and that the details could change.
The massive amount of money being sunk into AI compute deals has spooked a certain segment of investors , who worry that companies are spending too much money for too little profit.
Both Anthropic and Nscale are also currently pursuing IPOs.
